jcr:title: Suppliers
jcr:description: Stryker’s global supply chain management emphasizes quality. Access supplier standards, tools and policies to support compliance and collaboration.
cq:name: suppliers

text_2090364700.text:
At Stryker, our mission to make healthcare better is made possible through strategic partnerships with suppliers who share our values and commitment to excellence. We recognize the critical role our suppliers play in supporting the patients and customers we serve around the world. We look for supplier partners who perform at the highest levels across key areas—technology, quality, responsiveness, delivery, cost and overall business health, including financial stability, risk management and environment, human rights and ethics compliance. These are the foundations of a reliable, responsible supply chain—and essential to achieving our shared goals.

We’re proud to work alongside suppliers who are as dedicated as we are to quality, innovation, ethical practices and making a meaningful difference in healthcare. Together, we can continue to raise the bar and strengthen our position as a world-class supply chain partner.

– Tony Long
Vice President, Chief Procurement Officer

text.text: We conduct our business in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations and in accordance with the highest ethical standards. We are committed to setting high expectations for ourselves and our suppliers that align with our mission and core values of Integrity, Accountability, People and Performance.

text_201603842.text:
Adherence to our Supplier Code of Conduct is required for any supplier doing business with us. Our Supplier Code of Conduct communicates our expectations for suppliers in key areas including:

  • Business integrity
  • Labor and human rights
  • Environment
  • Workplace health and safety
  • Management systems

curatedcta.CTATitle: Access our Supplier Code of Conduct

text.text: To help our suppliers succeed, we provide clear expectations, best practices and tools that support our shared mission to make healthcare better.

text_297637114.text: Our Supplier Quality Guidebook is intended to serve as a helpful resource providing our suppliers with an overview of our quality requirements and expectations specific to those supplying materials, components or products.

text_1642430878.text:
Digital tools for supplier collaboration

We use digital platforms to help streamline collaboration with our suppliers.

Login to Ariba to manage purchase orders, advanced shipping notices and invoicing. Two resources are available: SAP business network supplier portal training for select finished goods suppliers, and Ariba training for all other quality-impacting suppliers. Consult with your Stryker representative to confirm which resources are relevant to your engagement.

Note: These portals are for existing Stryker suppliers. Accessing them does not initiate or imply a business relationship with Stryker.

text_1993722526.text: Stryker’s Purchase Order (PO) terms and conditions outline the requirements and expectations for all suppliers conducting business with us. These terms reflect our commitment to quality, compliance and responsible business practices across our global supply chain.

curatedcta_180260102.CTATitle: Access our PO terms and conditions

text_1412504400_copy.text:
Stryker is committed to responsible sourcing and compliance with conflict minerals regulations.

Suppliers must exercise due diligence in their supply chains to mitigate potential risks of directly or indirectly supporting armed conflict and support Stryker's compliance with the Dodd Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act*, EU Conflict Minerals Regulation* and our Conflict Minerals Policy. Upon request, suppliers are expected to participate annually in providing Conflict Minerals Reporting Templates in a timely manner and promptly disclose any changes to the status of minerals they become aware of, including the conformant status of smelters or refiners within their supply chain that impact our products.

text.text: Suppliers play a vital role in delivering the high-quality outcomes our customers expect. We are committed to building collaborative relationships with suppliers that share our dedication to quality.

curatedcta_copy.CTATitle: Learn more on our Global Quality page

text.text: We aim to engage the best suppliers in the world. Our Global Supplier Inclusion Program helps by expanding visibility to suppliers with qualifications and capabilities that align with our needs.
